description: Volcano Engine AutoScaling event notification configuration. Configure event notifications for scaling activities in a specified scaling group. When a scaling activity triggers a specified event type, notifications are sent via cloud monitoring. Only one event notification can be configured for each scaling group.

EventTypes.description: Event notification type. Values: ScaleOutSuccess (successful scale-out activity), ScaleInSuccess (successful scale-in activity), ScaleOutError (failed scale-out activity), ScaleInError (failed scale-in activity), ScaleOutWarn (partially successful scale-out activity), ScaleInWarn (partially successful scale-in activity), ScaleReject (rejected scaling activity), ScaleOutStart (scaling group scale-out activity started), ScaleInStart (scaling group scale-in activity started), ScheduleTaskExpiring (scheduled rule expiration reminder).

NotificationType.description: Event notification method. Currently, only cloud monitoring notifications are supported. Value: cloudmonitor.

ScalingGroupId.description: Scaling group ID. You can call DescribeScalingGroups to query the scaling group ID.
